section.content: 本发明的课题为用红外线区域的激光可靠地对在芯片上层形成的熔断器进行激光熔断。本发明中的半导体集成电路具备：在半导体衬底的主表面一侧形成的布线构件；与布线构件连接且具有规定的厚度的熔断性构件；覆盖熔断性构件的底面和侧面的阻挡构件；覆盖阻挡构件的至少侧面部分的光吸收构件；以及埋置布线构件、熔断性构件、阻挡构件和光吸收构件的绝缘构件，光吸收构件的复介电常数与熔断性构件的复介电常数相比，具有实数项的绝对值小而虚数项大的值。希望光吸收构件的厚度为熔断性构件的熔断中使用的光显示出最大吸收效率的厚度的50％以上至300％以下。光吸收构件由氮化钽、氮化钨或氮化钛等构成。

To securely burn out a fuse formed in an upper layer of a chip by laser blow using an infrared laser beam. A semiconductor integrated circuit includes a wiring member formed on a main face of a semiconductor substrate, a fusing member which is connected to the wiring member and has a prescribed thickness, a barrier member which covers the bottom face and side faces of the fusing member, a light absorbing member which covers at least side face portions of the barrier member which covers the fusing member, and an insulating member which embeds the wiring member, the fusing member, the barrier member, and the light absorbing member. The complex permittivity of the light absorbing member has a real number part that is smaller in absolute value than that of the fusing member and an imaginary number part that is larger than that of the fusing member. The thickness of the light absorbing member is preferably 50% or more and 300% or less of the thickness that shows a maximum absorption efficiency for the light used to burn out the fusing member. The light absorbing member is composed of tantalum nitride, tungsten nitride, titanium nitride, or the like.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to semiconductor integrated circuit, particularly relate to and possess the semiconductor integrated circuit that can use the fuse that fuses earlier.

Background technology

In recent years, with DRAM (dynamic random access memory) or SRAM (static RAM) is the raising that the integrated level of the semiconductor integrated circuit of representative has obtained leap, because the cause of the inscrutable defective that produces in manufacturing process, the decline of rate of finished products is unescapable.As the method for avoiding this point, so that becoming the method for qualified product, chip integral body realizing practicability by in circuit, setting in advance redundant circuit and the defected memory cell in the main memory unit being replaced into spare memory cell.The a kind of of this method is laser blown.

In laser blown, the most usually use fuse as main storage being converted to the element that shelf storage is used.Figure 13 (a) be from directly over to see existing be the figure of the fuse of main component with aluminium, Figure 13 (b) represents its section B-B '.

Among the figure, the 2nd, the interlayer dielectric between hardware 3 and silicon substrate 1, the 4th, the passivating film of configuration above hardware 3, these dielectric films are waited by the oxide of silicon or nitride and form.Hardware 3 is made of aluminum bronze, and its upper surface and lower surface are covered by the barrier metal layer 9 (the upper surface double as prevents reflectance coating) that the material by Ti, TiN etc. constitutes.Constituted fuse with hardware 3 and barrier metal layer 9.

In laser blown, generally use wavelength to belong to the laser of the infrared spectral range of 1.0 μ m to 1.4 μ m.If to hardware 3 irradiating lasers 5, the barrier metal member 9a (preventing reflectance coating) that then covers the upper surface of the covering hardware 3 in the barrier metal layer up and down 9 mainly absorbs the energy of laser 5.The barrier metal member 9a that has absorbed laser 5 heats up sharp, is used to come heating of metal member 3 from the heat conduction of barrier metal layer 9.

If hardware 3 is heated, then be changed to gas sharp through liquid from solid, utilize the rapid pressure that produces at this moment to change and dispel passivating film 4.Hardware 3 is fused simultaneously, and fusing phenomenon thus is through with.About the fusing phenomenon of hardware 3, open the spy and to have carried out detailed narration in the 2000-208635 communique.

In semiconductor integrated circuit, require the high speed of driving and the singualtion of system, the multilayer structured progress that obtaining of the low resistanceization of employed Wiring member and chip.From the viewpoint of low resistanceization of wiring, the copper wiring is realizing that practicability is to replace existing aluminium wiring.To the influence that laser blown produces, can enumerate following some as the material of such semiconductor integrated circuit and structural variation.

At first, companion chip multilayer structured requires to form fuse at the wiring layer that is arranged in the upper strata as far as possible.For the wiring layer that is positioned at the chip upper layer part, to dwindle wire distribution distance and improve operating frequency in order to take into account, reducing resistance is necessary item, consequently increases thickness.

Therefore, the wiring layer that will be positioned at the upper strata uses this point not only to mean as fuse layer fusible material is changed to copper, and means the thickness that increases fuse.The thickness that increases fuse means the decline of laser towards the transmission efficiency of fuse, makes laser blown become difficult.

On the other hand, different with the situation that the aluminium wiring layer is made fuse in the copper fuse that for example forms with inlaying process, for technologic consideration, become structure with 3 (2 sides and bottom surfaces) of barrier metal layer covering copper member.That is, in common copper fuse, on the upper surface of hardware 3, do not form barrier metal member 9a.

Thereby, in existing copper fuse, owing to the major part of the laser that shines for laser blown by the reflection of the copper on the surface of fuse, so as long as the laser of the wavelength of use infrared spectral range just is difficult to carry out reliably laser blown.

Summary of the invention

The present invention carries out in order to solve problem as described above, even its purpose is to provide the semiconductor integrated circuit that also can carry out laser blown under the situation that consideration uses the copper wiring layer of the upper layer part that is positioned at chip to use as fuse layer reliably with the laser of the wavelength with infrared spectral range to fuse.

Embodiment

Since copper for the reflection of light rate of infrared spectral range up to (reflectivity of aluminium is about 97% in this wavelength region may) more than 98%, so be provided with the light-absorbing member that absorbs laser effectively in the present invention.In an embodiment of the present invention, use the laser of infrared spectral range that the copper fuse is carried out laser blown, even but, also can use method of the present invention for the fuse of aluminium or tungsten etc.

Fig. 1 (a) is the profile of expression from the state of laterally seeing the fuse relevant with the present invention, in addition, Fig. 1 (b) expression from directly over read fortune with the state in zone.In the figure, the 2nd, the interlayer dielectric (the 1st dielectric film) that forms in the first type surface of silicon (semiconductor) substrate 1 (formed circuit etc. a face) side.Described interlayer dielectric 2 with one deck, but in fact can be stacked as multilayer with the tegillum that connects up.Hardware (fusing property member) 6 is being to be formed in the identical layer with the wiring 10c that is provided with in the superiors, but according to the situation of circuit, the situation that also has the lower floor in the superiors to be set up.

Wiring 10a, 10b compare with hardware 6 and are positioned at its lower floor, are connected with wiring 10c through bolt 6a, the 6b of conductivity.If with laser 5 fuse the wiring 10c, then connect up 10a with the wiring 10b conducting blocked, main storage is converted to shelf storage.Passivating film (the 2nd dielectric film) 4 contacts with the upper surface of wiring 10c, and this passivating film 4 is to be set up on the surface of outermost in order to protect the circuit that comprises wiring.

Fig. 2 is that explanation is the figure that the structure of the fuse of main component is used with copper, with the cross section A-A among Fig. 1 (b) ' quite.At for example thickness is in the hardware 6 of 1 μ m, in order to suppress the reaction with interlayer dielectric 2, has formed the barrier metal layer 9 (for example TaN etc.) that thickness is about 20nm on 3 faces of hardware 6 (2 side and bottom surface).In the inboard of barrier metal layer 9,, the situation of the metal level (for example Ta etc. is not shown) that thickness is set is about 15nm is arranged also in order to improve the connecting airtight property with hardware 6.In the outside of barrier metal layer 9, be provided with absorbed layer 7 with side wall portion 7a and bottom 7b.Fuse is made of hardware 6, barrier metal layer 9 and absorbed layer 7.

Absorbed layer 7 is made of the material of the laser 5 that absorbs the infrared spectral range that laser blown uses effectively.Side wall portion 7a there is no need to have identical thickness with bottom 7b, in order to reduce the residue that produces because of laser blown, wishes that bottom 7b is than side wall portion 7a thin (with reference to Fig. 2).If say terrifically, then the thickness of bottom 7b can be zero.

This be because, since compare less at the absorption of the laser of bottom 7b and side wall portion 7a a lot, so when laser blown, be used to heat and the bottom 7b of the absorbed layer 7 that fuses from the heat conduction of side wall portion 7a with from the heat conduction of hardware 6.Therefore, the thickness of the absorbed layer 7 (bottom 7b) that exists in the fuse bottom so long as when forming wiring the MIN thickness of desired necessity get final product.

The thickness of hardware 6 is as shown in Fig. 1 (a), identical with thickness with the wiring 10c of one deck.This is because by will using as fuse with the wire structures of one deck itself, reach from cost that the manufacturing for fuse all is favourable in view of technology.But, further increasing under the situation of wiring thickness from now on, since impossible from expecting that physically laser blown becomes, so preferably make the Film Thickness Ratio of fuse thin with the thickness of the wiring portion in one deck.

Wavelength shown in Figure 3 is tantalum, tantalum nitride, titanium, the complex refractivity index of titanium nitride and the value of complex dielectric permittivity of the situation of 1047nm (1.047 μ m).If compare with the copper shown in this figure, then 4 kinds of materials having narrated more than as can be known all satisfy above-mentioned condition.In addition, also can enumerate tungsten nitride (WN) etc.

For absorbed layer 7 absorbs laser effectively, thickness to a certain degree is necessary, if but thicker than necessary thickness, then cause the failure of laser blown easily.For example, forming with tantalum nitride (TaN) under the situation of absorbed layer 7, wavelength be the absorption efficiency of laser of 1047nm (1.047 μ m) and absorbed layer 7 thickness relation as shown in Figure 4.The result of this figure utilizes stacked unlimited parallel plane model to calculate.

Shown in this figure, under laser incided situation on the tantalum nitride, if the thickness of tantalum nitride is about more than the 25nm, then energy absorption efficiency was in saturation condition.This thickness is called the absorption efficiency maximum film thickness.

That is, under the situation of the laser radiation of considering certain certain hour, in thickness was tantalum nitride more than the 25nm, the volume of the necessary object of laser blown increased manyly than projectile energy, and like this, the laser blown failed probability has just improved.According to this point, the thickness that comparatively it is desirable to absorbed layer 7 be in the efficiency of light absorption maximum film thickness 50% to 300% in, in addition, if be in 50% to 200% with interior then even more ideal.Figure 5 illustrates the absorption efficiency maximum film thickness of each material of obtaining by calculating.

As the method that absorbed layer 7 is set, can consider for example such inlaying process shown in Fig. 6 (a)～(d).At first, (a) on silicon substrate 1, form interlayer dielectric 2, (b) utilize method such as etching in interlayer dielectric 2, to form the wiring figure groove.Moreover, (c) utilize the technology comprise metallide that absorbed layer 7c, barrier metal layer 9c, wiring layer 6c are carried out film forming, utilize (d) that to wait with CMP (chemico-mechanical polishing) be that the redundance that the technology of representative has been removed absorbed layer 7c, barrier metal layer 9c, wiring layer 6c forms passivating film 4 afterwards.

According to the operation shown in Fig. 6 (a)～(d),, can realize having the fuse of the such cross-section structure of Fig. 2 by before the formation of barrier metal layer 9, forming absorbed layer 7c.In the method, also can form wiring 10c with one deck.If do like this, though in wiring, do not need absorbed layer 7 originally, owing to make fuse and wiring with identical technology, so simplified operation.

Have again,, in the stage of (c), use RIE etching methods such as (reactive ion etchings) to remove bottom surface sections and get final product for the thickness of the bottom 7b that makes absorbed layer 7 thin thickness than side wall portion 7a.In addition, in Fig. 2 or Fig. 6, barrier metal layer 9 is illustrated as different layers with absorbed layer 7, but form absorbed layer 7, also can omit barrier metal layer 9 by material (for example, TaN or TiN etc.) with the condition that satisfies barrier metal layer 9.

As opening the spy as shown in the flat 11-297835 communique,, the energy absorption towards the laser of hardware incident is distributed with very big influence according to the relation of length direction with the direction of an electric field that is shone of hardware.Under the situation of having used the laser with component part of electric field vector parallel with the length direction of hardware 6, the absorption of laser concentrates on the surface and the top edge part (with reference to Fig. 7 (a)) of hardware 6.On the other hand, under the situation of having used laser with component part of electric field vector vertical with the length direction of hardware 6, the absorption of laser not only is dispersed in the surface and the top edge part of hardware 6, but also is distributed to side and lower edge (with reference to Fig. 7 (b)).

As shown in Figure 13 (b), this situation is positioned at barrier metal member 9a under the situation on the upper surface of hardware 3 does not become problem, but in hardware 6, because barrier metal layer 9 not only is positioned on the fuse surface but also is positioned on side wall portion and the bottom, be important so the electric field intensity of control laser fuses.That is, in order reliably fuse to be carried out laser blown, it is effective controlling the electric field intensity of laser like this, promptly using the laser that has the component part of electric field vector vertical with the length direction of fuse at least to fuse.

Having illustrated can be effectively with the situation of concentration of energy on the side wall portion 7a of absorbed layer 7 by the electric field intensity that is controlled at the laser that uses in the fuse blows, but in fact not that side wall portion 7a to absorbed layer 7 heats equably, distribute but exist like that as shown in Figure 8 to absorb.

In Fig. 8, show the high zone 8 of absorption of laser with semicircle.This distribution is relevant with employed Wavelength of Laser, is starting point, presents the high zone of absorption efficiency of energy at the integral multiple place of every half-wavelength with the fuse top edge.As shown in Figure 9, this situation exists peak value corresponding with the energy density (solid line) of light in every half-wave strong point.In the figure, dotted line is represented the amplitude that illustrates and the relation of phase place for the purpose of reference.

Thereby, be controlled near the integral multiple of half-wavelength by height (degree of depth) absorbed layer 7, even the thickness thickening of hardware 6 also can apply the energy of laser reliably to the underclad portion of fuse, the cut-out residue of the fuse bottom in the time of can being suppressed at laser blown.The height of absorbed layer 7, as shown in Figure 9, the zone 70% or more of wishing to be in energy value and be maximum energy value is interior, promptly, if be converted into the half-wavelength of laser, then wish half-wavelength ± 37% in.

If use mathematical expression to show above content, the scope of the height (degree of depth) of desirable absorbed layer 7 then be shown with following formula.

mλ/2-0.37(λ/2)～mλ/2+0.37(λ/2)

At this, m is the integer more than 1, and λ is a Wavelength of Laser.Wherein, wavelength X is the wavelength that surrounds in the medium of absorbed layer 7.For example, be under the situation of 1.047 μ m in employed Wavelength of Laser, (refractive index: 1.45), this wavelength is equivalent to 0.72 μ m at interlayer dielectric 2.

The energy that the laser that absorbed layer 7 is absorbed with thickness has been shown among Figure 10 when fuse being shone the laser of certain energy has carried out normalized value.The laser energy that is absorbed by the per unit thickness is followed the increase of thickness and periodically change, as having illustrated among Fig. 8, presents the high peak value of energy absorption efficiency at the integral multiple place of every half-wavelength.Therefore, even fuse is shone same energy, be designed to satisfy above-mentioned conditional by the thickness with fuse, laser also can rise nearly 10% to the efficient maximum of the energy that fuse is supplied with.The height of peak value increases with integer m and reduces (become and be difficult to fusing).

In addition, Figure 10 shows the thickness relation relevant with Wavelength of Laser that presents peak value in energy efficiency.From this figure as can be known,, compare the fuse fuse of same thickness of available lower energy with the laser that uses wavelength 1.3 μ m by using the laser of wavelength 1.0 μ m.

Figure 11 represents the relation of height and whole laser energies that absorbed layer 7 absorbs of fuse.From this figure as can be known, integer m is big more, and whole laser energies that absorbed layer 7 absorbs increase more.And because integer m is big more, the cloth line resistance reduces more, so on the basis that the RC that reduces signal postpones, integer m is preferably more than 2.But, increasing with integer m, the volume of absorbed layer 7 and hardware 6 increases, as shown in Figure 10, because the minimizing of the height of peak value, so the possibility of laser blown failure has increased.On the basis of the reliability of guaranteeing laser blown, integer m is preferably below 3.Therefore, if consider the low resistanceization of wiring and the reliability of laser blown simultaneously, then integer m 2 or 3 wishes most.If further increase the thickness of wiring, then, can think that also the reliability that makes laser blown becomes top-priority aspect by compare a thickness in attenuate fusing zone under these conditions with the thickness of the wiring portion that in one deck, is provided with.

Have again, existing on the chip between the circuit block of intending circuit or memory circuitry etc. for connection mode at loose routing that the chip upper layer part is provided with and between and these the 2 kinds of wirings of local wiring that are provided with for Connection Element.In local wiring, can utilize scaled (scaling) to reduce RC and postpone, seek to improve frequency, but in loose routing, if wiring is narrowed down, then along with change to a new generation from the older generation for the area that increases chip integral body, resistance value increases, and RC postpones also to have increased.Therefore, the low resistance that realizes loose routing on the basis of the high speed of seeking semiconductor integrated circuit changes into the problem into particularly urgent.

A kind of method that the resistance of reduction loose routing is used is the area of section of expansion wiring.If enlarge the area of section of wiring on the basis that keeps certain certain integrated level, then the thickness of wiring increases.Even supposition is 0% with the amplification degree inhibition of chip, loose routing is also thick than 1.0 μ m.According to the present invention, though for such increase the fuse in the loose routing of thickness, also can be corresponding with it.

Have again, as shown in Figure 12, also can form the high high refractive index layer 11 (at passivating film 4 is under the situation of silica, for example SiN film, SiON film etc.) of refractive index of refractive index ratio passivating film 4 in the bottom of fuse.This high refractive index layer 11 not necessarily needs to contact with the bottom 7b (under the situation that does not have bottom 7b is the bottom of barrier metal layer 9) of absorbed layer 7.Owing to the part of the laser that shines for laser blown incides on hardware 6 and the absorbed layer 7 after being passivated film 4 reflections once more, so improved the utilization ratio of energy.Its result can realize the little laser blown of influence of the outer part of the fuse etc. to silicon substrate 1 or adjacency.
